description: This file defines an audio management system for a React-based web application, handling ambient sounds and sound effects using HTMLAudioElement. It provides context and hooks for controlling audio playback across the app.

methods.name: createAudio(tag)
methods.description: Creates an HTMLAudioElement configured with parameters from the audioBank based on a given tag.

methods.name: AudioProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides audio control functions (play, stop, ensureAmbient) via context, managing audio states.

methods.name: useSFX()
methods.description: Custom hook to access the audio control context.
